'''Shai Tenna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] who was the leader of a [[Shai Tenna's crew|group]] belonging to the [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Of course, I killed both my brothers.|Shai Tenna|<ref name="TOR" />}}
In [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Galactic War]], Tenna was sent to [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] by [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher]] to take over the [[White Maw]] pirate gang. At the same time, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] later known as the [[Voidhound]], working as a privateer for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], arrived on the frozen [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in search of a cloaking device that enabled the White Maw to hide their ships.<ref name="TOR" />

Tenna's lackey [[Languss Tuno]] set up a meeting between his superior and the Voidhound, the latter seeking to join the White Maw. Tenna told the smuggler that they need to perform a task for him before he inducts them. His rival, [[Kandhar]], was dealing with Imperials to acquire cold-weather [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] to gain favor with the White Maw's [[Gen'Dai/Legends|Gen'Dai]] leaders. Tenna left the details on how to accomplish this to his slave, [[Alilia]].<ref name="TOR" />

After the Voidhound accomplished this task by turning Kandhar's own men against him, Tenna reneged on their deal and threw the smuggler into a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] cave and began a coup against the White Maw.<ref name="TOR" />

Tenna later confronted the Voidhound in the wreckage of the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'', after having captured the turncoat Tuno. The smuggler had discovered that the cloaking device was actually a mentally-impaired [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]] known as [[Trick (Kitonak)|Trick]]. Tenna and his men attacked the Voidhound but the gangster was killed in the fight.<ref name="Trick">{{TORcite|type=class|[[Voidhound|Smuggler]]|Trick or Treat|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>
